subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable contract should replace full per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving `/context` reporting and bootstrap warning dedupe?
rationale: The source fix is not just mechanical because current tests and linked PRs preserve `systemPromptReport` for warning dedupe, while production data shows the full payload is now the main store bloat.

options.title: Compact durable report state
options.body: Persist only the small warning-dedupe and current-report fields needed by runtime surfaces, and drop or recompute bulky tool/skill breakdowns for inactive rows.

options.title: Move reports out of line
options.body: Store full reports in a bounded content-addressed or session-scoped artifact and keep only references in `sessions.json`, accepting a new storage lifecycle to maintain.

options.title: Keep current persistence
options.body: Treat the bloat as acceptable for now and rely on session maintenance caps, leaving this issue open or closing only after that product decision is explicit.

recommendation.title: Compact durable report state
recommendation.body: Persist only the small warning-dedupe and current-report fields needed by runtime surfaces, and drop or recompute bulky tool/skill breakdowns for inactive rows.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prompt-blob mitigation and has the strongest recent history in the session persistence design area.
